## TeX mathematics — inline and display

Start with \(x^2+y^2=z^2\).
\[
\boxed{\frac{a}{b}=\frac{1}{2}}.
\]
A raw aligned derivation follows.
\[
\begin{aligned}
a&=b\\[2mm]
b&=c
\end{aligned}
\]
This paragraph ends with \(a=c\).

## Single-line displays

The variable \(n\) appears in an inline object.

\[x+y=z\]
Ordinary prose separates the displays.

$$\sum_{i=1}^n i$$
Finish with \(n+1\).
